confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use 2026 Turkish price figures surfaced by search (Numbeo, Hikersbay, Gotripzi, livingcost.org, Vahada, NightCalc, Expatistan), with lira converted at about 48-49 per US dollar as implied by those sources. Beer, coffee and meal anchors agree across sources. Cocktail and wine are weaker (national bar medians, a modeled index, a club listing) and were cross-checked against draft-beer price ratios. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates assuming July peak season, not checked against live listings or booking pages (low confidence). Most price data are dated Oct-Nov 2026, after the July 2026 reference window. FX: the latest RBA observation I could retrieve is dated 2026-03-20; a later observation could not be found, so fx may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mediterranean resort city in Turkey (a transcontinental country), placed in Europe as the closest list region. Turkish price levels run generally below southern-European resorts, so anchors follow Turkish local and tourist-area price data; accommodation anchors are holistic comparisons with Mediterranean resort towns at Turkish price levels.
